notes: Ducati R5, R8, R14, R6T power factor controllers. All readings use FC03 (holding registers). Addresses are as documented in Annex A (the runtime subtracts 1 for wire protocol). All measurement registers are 2-word (32-bit). 'Unsigned Long' = uint32, 'Bit-Signed Long' = int32_signmag (MSB=1 means negative, NOT two's complement). R5 has fewer registers than R8/R14. Per-phase L2/L3 registers (R14-only) trimmed to fit intelligence registers within 32-register limit — use voltage_l1/current_l1/pf_l1 + equivalent for monitoring.
address_note: Physical wire address = documented address - 1. The register addresses below are the DOCUMENTED addresses (as shown in the Ducati manual). The runtime must subtract 1 before sending on the wire.
intelligence_notes: This profile prioritizes capacitor bank health intelligence: step status, breakage detection, contactor wear (insertion counts), real kVAR per step (degradation), and alarm status. Combined with PF, THD, and temperature readings, the Opta can detect: (1) capacitor degradation (real_power < rated), (2) contactor end-of-life (max_insertion_exceeded), (3) resonance (THD alarms), (4) hunting (rapid step switching via battery_status changes), (5) PF non-compliance for Codigo de Red.

registers._threshold_note: Thresholds are % deviation from Vnom. Application code must convert to absolute V based on site Vnom. CdR: permanent ±5%, temporary ±10%.

registers.description: Phase-neutral voltage L1 (representative phase for unbalance)
Three-phase equivalent power factor (Bit-Signed Long). CdR: ≥0.95 until Apr 2026, ≥0.97 after.
Three-phase equivalent reactive power (Bit-Signed Long). Key for CdR: positive = lagging (inductive), capacitors reduce this.
THD current line 1 (thousandths of fundamental). CdR IEEE-519: limits depend on Icc/IL ratio.
THD voltage line 1 (thousandths of fundamental). CdR IEEE-519: ≤5% DATD for ≤69kV.
Internal temperature (tenths of °C). High temp = capacitor degradation accelerator.
Delta-kVAr (remaining compensation needed to reach target PF). Near zero = bank is compensating well.

Alarms status bitfield. Bit0=high_voltage, Bit1=high_current, Bit2=low_voltage, Bit3=low_current, Bit4=THDI%, Bit5=THDV%, Bit6=temperature, Bit7=fan(R8/R14), Bit8=high_cosfi, Bit9=low_cosfi, Bit10=voltage_dip. Any bit=1 is an active alarm.

Battery Breakage Status. Each bit = one step (Bit0=C1, Bit1=C2...). 1=BROKEN — controller detected capacitor failure via power measurement comparison. Critical: broken capacitor = reduced compensation capacity = PF drops.
Maximum Battery Insertion Status. Each bit = one step. 1=EXCEEDED max operations count — contactor at end of mechanical life. Schedule replacement before welding failure.
Battery Status (which steps are currently inserted). Each bit = one step (Bit0=C1, Bit1=C2...). 1=INSERTED, 0=NOT INSERTED. Rapid changes = hunting behavior.
Physical relays status. Each bit = one relay. 1=CLOSED, 0=OPEN. Compare with battery_status for stuck relay detection.
Number of insertions — Step C1. Tracks contactor switching operations. Compare with max_insertion_exceeded.
Real reactive power delivered by Step C1. Compare with rated kVAR to detect capacitor degradation (real < 80% rated = degraded).
